global_model.transform: RGB; resize 440x440 bilinear; ImageNet normalization; L2

appearance_evidence.policy: Existing evidence read only; new measurements stored in this report only.

saved_report_audit.method: Read-only validation of existing reports and assignment arithmetic; no models, clustering or tests executed.

limitations: Calibration only; selection has not been evaluated for clustering.
Global-only controls; no calibrated local fusion or new training.
Unknown flank labels and colour proxies do not establish validated night/IR or opposite-flank treatment.
Photographed-individual counts do not establish park abundance.
First deterministic visual examples are a bounded review, not a full audit.

visual_review.policy: First preselected false-merge examples for threshold k15/.35 and consistent k15/.35; first fragmentation and cross-appearance-proxy examples for consistent k15/.35.
observations: Threshold false-merge pair has different reference identities, different poses and illumination; occluding vegetation is visible in one crop. These examples do not establish a direct graph edge between the pictured endpoints.
Consistent false-merge pair has different reference identities, one monochrome crop and one colour crop, with different poses.
Same-identity fragmentation example has different cameras and poses; the second crop provides a rear/oblique view.
Same-identity appearance-proxy example has a bright colour crop and a dark monochrome partial/occluded crop.
visual_review.limitations: Eight thumbnails only; no original-frame or full per-identity audit. Flank and actual night/IR labels remain unverified. Visible differences do not establish the cause of an embedding error.

review_decision.reason: None of the 25 global-only controls provides reliable photographed-individual grouping/counting on calibration. Preserve selection while proposing a calibration-only pair/connectivity diagnostic.
